Assets.NotesMarkdown:
# Terminal 1.0.102

1. Fixed: after "Restart to update" the app no longer shows a crash notice at the next start.
2. The TradeNextFX logo mark and app icon are the brand's own artwork, and the name at the top left, on the sign-in window and in the status line shows in the brand's own two colours.
3. Each broker's app keeps its own saved sign-ins and settings, so apps from different brokers on one PC never share them. Settings has an Uninstall option that also removes this app's saved data (ticked by default).
4. Chart: zoom in much further, so a few candles can fill the chart; candles are solid with crisp edges and wicks in both themes.
5. Chart: at the live right edge the chart follows new candles as they form; scrolled back into history it stays where you left it.
6. Chart: the Indicators, Drawing tools, Layout and right-click menus share one clean style in both themes.
7. Chart settings: a new layout with sections on the left (Symbol, Status line, Scales and lines, Canvas, Trading sessions), colour swatches with a palette, a Template button and Cancel / Save.
8. Drawing tools: every tool is drawn crisp and smooth at any angle and size; hovering a drawing shows its handles and makes it slightly bolder, with no halo.
9. Positions on the chart: each tag sits at its own price; the dotted line keeps the same clearly visible dots at any zoom; lines and tags are easier to click; where several positions overlap a click lists them so you pick the one you want; the close cross turns red under the pointer; a selected position's line and tag are highlighted.
